subsets.name: reference
subsets.selection_rule: Sort each stratum by SHA256(dvr-person-qualification-v1|image_id), take first 50.

subsets.name: tiling
subsets.selection_rule: Sort each stratum by SHA256(dvr-person-qualification-v1|image_id), take positions 50 through 99 (zero-based), disjoint from earlier 0 through 49.

subsets.name: confidence
subsets.selection_rule: Sort each stratum by SHA256(dvr-person-qualification-v1|image_id), take positions 100 through 149 (zero-based), excluding both earlier image subsets.
